findings.problem: In Germany a train station is der Bahnhof, which is masculine, so the natural answer is zum Bahnhof; the hint saying the noun is feminine pushes the learner toward the rare zur Station.

back.target: to the (zu + der: zu with the dative of a feminine noun)

note: With the prompt changed to bank (zur Bank), the current hint still works, because it rules out other ways to say to the, such as in die.
